hadith:
Prayers (Salat) - Narrated Ibn `Abbas:

Once I came riding a she-ass when I had just attained the age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was offering the prayer at Mina with no wall in front of him and I passed in front of some of the row. There I dismounted and let my she-ass loose to graze and entered the row and nobody objected to me about it.
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Aakhir - الآخِرُ - The Last

The name Al Aakhir signifies that Allah is the ultimate end of all existence. In Islamic theology, this name emphasizes His eternal nature and the idea that everything in the universe has a beginning and an end, but Allah remains beyond the constraints of time. It reflects the belief in the Day of Judgment and the finality of His will.
verse:
Al-Mujadila - The Pleading Woman - 58:14

Have you not seen those ˹hypocrites˺ who ally themselves with a people with whom Allah is displeased? They are neither with you nor with them. And they swear to lies knowingly.
